donnees.titre_officiel: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Teleophthalmology for Glaucoma Screening: A Randomized Controlled Trial
collaborateurs: Los Angeles County Department of Health Services (DHS)

criteres_principaux.critere: Time to in-office diagnosis of glaucoma

donnees.resume_source: This randomized controlled trial will compare an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted teleglaucoma referral pathway with conventional referral among adults identified with referable glaucoma through the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services (LAC DHS) Teleretinal Screening Program. The primary objective is to determine whether AI-assisted referral reduces time to in-office diagnosis of manifest glaucoma. Secondary outcomes include glaucoma severity, visual function, need for glaucoma surgery, patient-reported quality of life and satisfaction, health system resource utilization, and cost-effectiveness.

bras.description: Participants will undergo AI-assisted referral using validated deep learning models integrated within the Eye-AI platform. AI outputs, together with intraocular pressure and other clinical information, will be used to stratify referral urgency. AI-generated recommendations will be reviewed by glaucoma specialists before referral.

Participants will undergo conventional teleglaucoma referral based on manual grading of fundus photographs by LAC DHS optometrists, with referral and prioritization performed according to current clinical practice.

eligibilite.criteres:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Provision of signed and dated informed consent
* Age ≥18 years
* Receiving routine teleretinal screening through the Los Angeles County Department of Health Services (LAC DHS) Teleretinal Screening Program
* Positive prediction for referable glaucoma by the validated AI algorithm at the time of screening
* No prior ophthalmology or optometry follow-up within the past year
* Willingness and ability to comply with study procedures and follow-up

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to tolerate fundus photography or ungradable fundus images
* Acute vision loss or major ocular complaints requiring immediate in-person evaluation
* Prior glaucoma diagnosis or treatment within the past year

criteres_secondaires.critere: Mean retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thickness
